card.name: Anticipating the negative side
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right after a contrast between good and bad outcomes, where the next word is likely to be "negative", "failed" or similar. Seen after phrases like "whether positive or" and "not".

modes.label: Positive or negative
modes.description: Comma or "or" after "positive" when results are being contrasted with negative ones.

modes.label: After "not" in contrast
modes.description: Article or word after "not" that sets up the unsuccessful or unwanted side of a contrast.
modes.example: “Black is not<< a>> color, white is a color.”

modes.label: Failures versus successes
modes.description: Punctuation or words before mention of mistakes or failures.
modes.example: they might learn even more from the mistakes<<,>> such as the failed Mars Polar Lander

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like "negative", "unsuccessful" and "failure" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name the negative or failed side of a contrast.
